desc: Verify operation swaps d_i and d_{i+2} (three gaps reverse to (d_{i+2}, d_{i+1}, d_i)); adjacent transpositions generate full permutations within each parity class.
Confirm invariants: x_1 and x_N fixed; total sum = N*x_1 + sum_{j=1}^{N-1} (N-j)*d_j.
Derive minimization rule: within each parity class pair largest gaps with smallest weights (rearrangement inequality).
Implement O(N log N) solution (sort odd/even gaps descending, weights ascending) and validate against both samples and boundary cases.
